name: Senior JD
description: Takes an existing senior-role job post and returns a single rewritten version formatted for Greenhouse, Ashby or LinkedIn. Assumes you already have a draft to hand rather than a blank page, and is aimed at founders and hiring managers filling one senior seat at a time.
